About

AI deployment strategist based in London.

Before that: 5 years at EY-Parthenon advising Fortune 500 and FTSE 100 companies. Set up the EY-Parthenon AI Lab and wrote the UK AI strategy. Clients spanned F1, Formula E, US retail, and PE-backed tech.

In August 2025: built, launched, and sold a company in 20 hours at a Stockholm hackathon - the fastest exit in Europe. That became the20hr.co.

Also founder of Unicorn Mafia, a developer community of 1000+ engineers across the EU and US.

Oxford Economics & Management following dropping out of Durham Engineering.
